Request to remap the below two SAP accounts for Capitalised Interest Equity from hyperion account 1755 (Other Sterling Capital) to hyperion 1690 (Other Income -Other)               Effective: for SEPTEMBER 2024 Close.

     SAP Accounts      Description                             From: Current Mapping              To: New Mapping
          78892830     Capitalised Interest Settlement        1755_78892830                     1690_78892830
          60765877     Capitalised Interest                       1755_60765877                     1690_60765877

Capitalised interest (SAP accounts 78892830-Capitalised Interest Settlement and 60765877-Capitalised Interest) map to Sterling Capital 1755-interest capitalized.  The only companies using these two SAP accounts as of July and the YTD credit balances in each of them are companies 141-£412,155, 179-£254,270, 413-£9,801 (debit), 536-£2,372,408, 60-£70,691 and 62-£224,438.

In conclusion I have reviewed the proposed remapping with representatives of the various Corporate Lending companies and they confirmed the remapping would not present any problems to them.

PS.   Pls notify me or Maurice Coleman when change is made in Leeds so he can remap same accounts in EOC hyperion. 
</quoted>
